We propose RAED (Retrieval-Augmented Entity Description), a retrieval-based framework designed to tackle the emerging entity challenge. Given a single mention of an entity, RAED generates a title and a definition by retrieving high-quality, contextually relevant information from external sources such as Wikipedia... RAED aims to generate a target description d for the corresponding entity... The target description d consists of the Wikipedia title and the article's opening sentence, separated by a special token <def>.
We formalize the entity description task as follows: given a mention m in a query q and a set of passages P(q) relevant to q, RAED aims to generate a target description d for the corresponding entity
